title: What a turnkey office fit-out includes
excerpt: One contract, one team and one timeline, from the first site survey to handover.
body:
A turnkey fit-out puts design and execution under one contract. The same team that measures your site and plans the layout also manages civil work, joinery, electrical, finishes and installation.

For the client, that means a single point of accountability, a single programme and fewer hand-offs where time and budget usually slip.
